podcast.title: Co-production of Antichrist Superstar
podcast.body: Sean Beavan, a frequent collaborator with Trent Reznor and Nine Inch Nails, co-produced "Antichrist Superstar" alongside Reznor and Marilyn Manson. He was a key part of the "ambitious project" of Nine Inch Nails. "como sin viva que había trabajado mucho con él que también coproduce con tren Retnor y con Mey Manson el anticristo superestar."

podcast.body: Sean Beavan, who was involved in Nine Inch Nails' ambitious projects and co-produced "Antichrist Superstar," continued his collaboration with Marilyn Manson on the subsequent album, "Mechanical Animals."
